headline: Niraj Cement Structurals Limited: Updates
sum: Updates — Niraj Cement Structurals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation of Recommendations of the Committee of Independent Directors ( IDC ) on the open offer to the shareholders of Niraj Cement Structurals Limited (…
detail: Updates — Niraj Cement Structurals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation of Recommendations of the Committee of Independent Directors ( IDC ) on the open offer to the shareholders of Niraj Cement Structurals Limited ( Company ) under Regulation 26(7) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 ( SEBI (SAST) Regulations )'.
